c74object.name: evi.vactrol~
c74object.digest: Vactrol response time domain filter envelope
c74object.description: Analog modelled vactrol opto isolator envelope emulation.

inlet.description: Audio to trigger the envelope, typically an impulse.
Envelope Rise Time in Samples. evi.vactrol~ does not reach it's value in this time exactly.
Envelope Fall Time in Samples. evi.vactrol~ does not reach it's value in this time exactly. Retriggering the envelope keeps the output above zero.

objarg.name: rise
objarg.description: Amount of time the envelope takes to rise. evi.vactrol~ does not rise in this time exactly. This value represents the initial charge of the opto isolator.

objarg.name: fall
objarg.description: Amount of time the envelope takes to fall. evi.vactrol~ does not fall in this time exactly. This value relates to the voltage-like release of the opto isolator. Repeated triggers at the left inlet will keep the envelope high.

objarg.name: scalar
objarg.description: Envelope Output Multiplier. This can be useful depending on use case, otherwise should be '1'.

method.name: int
method.description: In the middle inlet, rise time in samples.In the right inlet, fall time in samples.

method.name: float
method.description: In the middle inlet, rise time in samples.In the right inlet, fall time in samples.

method.name: signal
method.description: In the left inlet, the trigger value.In the middle inlet, rise time in samples.In the right inlet, fall time in samples.

attribute.name: fall
